reviews.title: Great gift!
reviews.comment: I got this for my fiancé as a Christmas gift as we got a great deal on it for Black Friday and it delivered! It was super easy to set up and is amazing quality. I know little to nothing about monitors and he was super impressed by this purchase. It’s hard to pull him away!! Not to mention how impressive it looks in our office.
reviews.author: Angie Davenport

reviews.title: This thing is beautiful but HUGE!!!
reviews.comment: Omg this thing is humongous! The screen looks amazing and the curve in envelopes you. This monitor paired with my Tobii eye and head tracker are an amazing pair in my opinion a better option than VR once you get it tuned into your play style. The base is heavier than the monitor so it is extremely stable and won’t be going anywhere when you might bump into it or anything. All around great the hight adjustment is extremely smooth but it is a little difficult to get it to stay exactly where you want it without resetting it and trying to get the exact spot again. The refresh rate and response time are top tier as well so very little flickering and stuttering if at all. I got it on sale for $800ish and I feel like I stole it at that price. All around 5 stars!
reviews.author: Jay M Smith-Sessa

reviews.author: It's me

reviews.title: Amazing for gaming and video content. Battlefield 6 is just sublime at this size.
reviews.comment: Driving a solid 240hz on BF6 with a RTX 5080. No tearing, buttery smooth. Its a big monitor but the curve makes it much more manageable for areas you can put it. I am including an image of where I am playing. Got the 34" first at BestBuy then started seeing much lower prices on bigger options. Returned that and saw this 45" in person and had to try it. Was a great price, lower at Amazon than BestBuy and better terms. I would buy this again. I also tried a 34" from Alienware/Dell. It was a pain having the do forced maintenance routines regularly. This monitor does it when its idling or gets turned off.  Included an image of the 45" and the 34" on the same desk for size reference. It does not look so agressively curved in person.
reviews.author: Casper the Friendly Dog

reviews.title: Product is as advertised!
reviews.comment: The product is as advertised and I am very pleased with the results, but I want to say that I am totally disappointed in Amazon and the delivery.  The very expensive electronic item was left in the rain and not on my front porch that is covered and protected from the rain.  Because of the size and weight of the item, I was unable to move it myself and had to wait until I could get help.  The monitor could have been ruined.  Fortunately all is well, for now.  Amazon delivers to my home weekly and knows that I have a front porch.
reviews.author: Sharon C.
